title: The 9 Best Vlogging Cameras and Gear for 2026 | Reviews by Wirecutter
snippet: Vlogging, or video blogging, is a way for you to share your life and interests with the world. If that happens, you’ll want to start investing seriously in your vlogging setup to ensure your content looks and sounds as good as it possibly can. We’ve put together a list of gear and some tips to help you get started, beginning with the smartphone you probably already have and working up through more expensive and specialized options as both your channel and your experience grow. If your phone isn’t cutting it, a dedicated vlogging camera can give you a selfie screen, plus better image quality and autofocus. For vloggers who are always on the go, a small camera with a built-in gimbal is ideal for walk-and-talks. If you’re sure you want to go beyond phone footage, and are confident that you’ll stick with vlogging either as a hobby or money-maker, we have recommendations for a variety of cameras that can elevate your image quality.
